comment: Curated first set (D-192). A pack is one download (D-191); its instruments share one sample pool. Names are descriptive and trademark-free. 'parts' are upstream SFZ files; 'articulation' maps an SFZ keyswitch label (sw_label, case-insensitive substring) or a whole part to a KIF articulation; 'keyswitch' values are MIDI notes. 'key_range' clips a part's zones (key splits); 'key_shift' moves an unpitched part to other keys.

release.why: Release assets must be anonymously downloadable; Charl-bot/katalyst-suite is private (D-191).

instruments.name: Concert Grand
instruments.description: Concert grand piano, close stereo pair; pedal-up and pedal-down sustains switched by the sustain pedal, plus key-release samples.

instruments.name: Studio Upright
instruments.description: Upright piano, two dynamics with four round robins, and key-release samples.

instruments.name: Flemish Harpsichord
instruments.description: Two-manual style harpsichord: 8' and 4' stops and both together, with key-release (jack) samples.
qa_notes: The 4' stop sounds an octave above the key by design (that is what a 4' register is); its octave suspects in this report are expected. Measured: 16 of the 4' samples sit +12 semitones above their key, the rest were not measurable unguided.

instruments.name: Pipe Organ

parts.why: Upstream maps written pitch; every sample measures +12 semitones above its root. Mapped at concert pitch (D-199).
Every sample measures +12 semitones above its mapped root. Mapped at concert pitch (D-199).

instruments.name: Jazz Club Kit
instruments.description: Jazz/club drum kit played with sticks, six mic positions with mix presets. GM-style key map; extra snare and tom techniques C6-C7. CC4 hi-hat pedal, CC21 snares off.

qa_notes: Key-up release time is the upstream default (release control at 0.5, one second); the release control, velocity-tracking control and sample-start offset are not exposed. Upstream's default velocity tracking (73%) is not applied: KIF velocity.track is 1.0.
Pedal noise (CC-triggered, silent keys) is omitted; sustain-pedal holding is the sampler's own.

instruments.name: Electric Grand
instruments.description: Electro-acoustic stage grand: struck strings with pickups, bright and percussive. CC BY 3.0.
qa_notes: Upstream ARIA controls (volume, pan, release and velocity-tracking CCs) are not carried over; the sampler's own controls replace them.

Upstream 'end' points that shorten a few top-octave and release samples, and the release group's group_volume (-2 dB, pad-plucked piano), are not applied: those samples play to their end and the releases are about 2 dB louder than upstream.
One upstream sample has a clipping run (reported in the QA, not repaired).
